**Joel Jigo** · computer science engineering student · Kochi, India

This is a dated survey of what I've built since March 2026, in the order it happened: two prototypes in the spring, a pair of systems over the summer, tooling and pull requests to other people's projects in September, and two releases in October.

Start with the releases, [**Pipo v1.0**](#pipo) and [**Campus Bus v1.1**](#campus-bus), or the [**upstream ledger**](#upstream).

## Early experiments

<sub><code>PLATE I</code> · MARCH–APRIL 2026</sub>

**[MediMind](https://github.com/aspire488/medimind)** set out to be a medication assistant for seniors, patients and caregivers, with an AI helper and a pill-dispenser bridge. What it implements is the reminder loop: reminders fire, are confirmed or snoozed, and never fire twice, on synthetic users only. [Demo ↗](https://medimind-seven.vercel.app/)

**[CodeFlow](https://github.com/aspire488/codeflow)** set out to teach C by showing pointers, recursion and loops as they run. What it implements is a line tracer for assignments, print statements and simple loops, plus step-through of pre-written traces; a small AST-based executor for the subset it teaches is written up as the next step, not built. [Demo ↗](https://codeflow-app-sigma.vercel.app)

Both were reopened on 10 and 21 September 2026 to set up or harden CI and add CodeQL, Dependabot and security headers, then frozen.

- **[KIO](https://github.com/aspire488/Kio)**, the Kernel for Intelligent Orchestration, is the execution core of a personal companion runtime. It advances through gates its repository records: C-1 context, C-2 registry and C-3 planning are marked done, and C-4, response separation, is next. Its anchored summary records a Phase 0 that deleted 5,167 lines. KIO has no public README yet; its design documents are in the repository root.
- **[AURA](https://github.com/aspire488/AURA)** is the memory and reasoning layer designed to pair with it: episodic, semantic and working memory, beliefs, goals and reasoning traces behind a FastAPI service. Its last commit was on 28 June 2026, and bringing it into KIO is gate C-7 in KIO's plan.

## Tooling and upstream

<sub><code>PLATE III</code> · SEPTEMBER–OCTOBER 2026</sub>

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="./assets/profile/tooling.dark.svg">

</picture>

- **[UEA](https://github.com/aspire488/Universal-Engineering-Augmentation)** moves repeatable engineering checks out of model reasoning and into deterministic tools: tree-sitter analysis, blast-radius impact, property and mutation testing, Z3 constraints. It's a public alpha, validated in CI on Python 3.10 to 3.12, and its README lists token savings as "not currently measured".
- **[gh-ops](https://github.com/aspire488/gh-ops)** is my GitHub operations layer on GitHub Actions: monitoring, security, weekly reports and open-source scouting. It's frozen, and its README records 1,495 passing tests at the freeze.
- **[OSS Atlas](https://github.com/aspire488/oss-atlas)** holds my notes, case studies and research on open-source work.

<a href="https://aspire488.github.io/Pipo/"><img src="./assets/profile/work/pipo-world.jpg" width="100%" alt="Pipo's 3D room in the browser: a small round robot stands on a rug between his bed, his desk and a workbench, with Nib, his pet robot, beside him."></a>

### Pipo

<sub><code>RELEASED · v1.0 · 4 OCT</code> &nbsp; Android 8.0+ · Kotlin · Three.js on GitHub Pages</sub>

A small robot with moods, memories, habits and projects who lives in a room on your phone. Nothing runs constantly: when the app reopens, or an hourly worker fires, the time you were away is replayed through the same behaviour engine, so something has changed when you come back. Sometimes he isn't home, just a note on the door. No account and no analytics. The browser version is a Three.js room with a live day–night cycle and his pet robot, Nib.

[**Visit the room ↗**](https://aspire488.github.io/Pipo/) &nbsp;·&nbsp; [Android APK v1.0 ↗](https://github.com/aspire488/Pipo/releases/tag/v1.0) &nbsp;·&nbsp; [Source ↗](https://github.com/aspire488/Pipo)

<br>

<a href="https://github.com/aspire488/campus-bus"><img src="./assets/profile/work/campus-bus-seat-map.png" width="100%" alt="Campus Bus seat map: a route from High Court to the campus with every stop and time, above a bus layout where seat 07 is selected."></a>

### Campus Bus

<sub><code>RELEASED · v1.1 · 18 OCT</code> &nbsp; Windows desktop · Java · Swing + JavaFX WebView · JDBC · MySQL 8</sub>

Seat reservation for a college transport office. Students find a bus by trip and stop, pick a seat on the bus map, and get a pass they can save as a PDF; the office manages buses, routes, timetables, students and reservations.

The Windows release is a 76 MB zip with its own Java 25 runtime built with `jlink`. Its setup script installs a private, per-user MySQL on port 3310 with no admin rights, gives every demo account a new random password, never prints one, and changes nothing when run again. The packaging script runs the tests before it builds the zip. The v1.1 zip was checked in a sandbox through first setup, a repeat setup, an interrupted setup, sign-in and shutdown; Windows 10 and a second PC were not tested.

[**Download v1.1 ↗**](https://github.com/aspire488/campus-bus/releases/tag/v1.1) &nbsp;·&nbsp; [Source ↗](https://github.com/aspire488/campus-bus) &nbsp;·&nbsp; [All screenshots ↗](https://github.com/aspire488/campus-bus/tree/main/docs/screenshots)
